test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that has NO spelling errors.

options.text: The clear blue waters of the laggon called to me, inviting me to dieve into its peaceful embrece.
The clear blue waters of the lagoon caled to me, inviting me to dieve into its peacefull embrace.
The clear blue waters of the lagon called to me, inviting me to dive into its peacefull embrece
The clear blue waters of the lagoon called to me, inviting me to dive into its peaceful embrace.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"lagoon"** means a stretch of salt water separated from the sea by a low sandbank or coral reef. (लैगून) • **Example: **The fishermen anchored their boat in the calm waters of the lagoon. • **"Dive" **refers to plunge headfirst into water. (गोताखोरी करना) • **Example: **She loves to dive into the deep end of the swimming pool. • **"Peaceful" **means free from disturbance; tranquil. (शांतिपूर्ण) • **Example: **The garden was a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle and bustle. • **"Embrace" **refers to hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection. (गले लगाना) • **Example: **She gave her mother a warm embrace after returning from the trip. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. The correct sentence is: **The clear blue waters of the lagoon called to me, inviting me to dive into its peaceful embrace. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The clear blue waters of the **laggon** called to me, inviting me to **dieve** into its peaceful **embrece**. • **Laggon** is incorrect, it should be **lagoon** (लैगून). • **Dieve** is incorrect, it should be **dive** (गोताखोरी करना). • **Embrece** is incorrect, it should be **embrace** (गले लगाना). • **Option 2:** The clear blue waters of the **lagoon** **caled** to me, inviting me to **dieve** into its **peacefull** embrace. • **Caled** is incorrect, it should be **called** (बुलाना). • **Dieve** is incorrect, it should be **dive** (गोताखोरी करना). • **Peacefull** is incorrect, it should be **peaceful** (शांतिपूर्ण). • **Option 3:** The clear blue waters of the **lagon** called to me, inviting me to dive into its **peacefull** **embrece**. • **Lagon** is incorrect, it should be **lagoon** (लैगून). • **Peacefull** is incorrect, it should be **peaceful** (शांतिपूर्ण). • **Embrece** is incorrect, it should be **embrace** (गले लगाना). 11f:Tc02, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
